source.manualTitle: Samsung Front-Load Washer BB8700 Family (WF50/53BB, WF51CG)
source.extractedTextFile: backend/docs/manuals/samsung fl washer new style wf50bb8700-extracted.txt

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Level sensor hose
steps.body: Check hose to water level sensor — not folded, cut, or damaged. Verify correct material code sensor installed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check hose to water level sensor — not folded, cut, or damaged. Verify correct material code sensor installed.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Correct hose routing and sensor part.

steps.title: Frequency check
steps.body: Connect sensor and connector. Measure frequency on pink and orange wires — approx. 25.5 kHz with no load.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connect sensor and connector. Measure frequency on pink and orange wires — approx. 25.5 kHz with no load.

steps.title: Terminal connections
steps.body: Water level sensor terminals secure and correct sensor part number?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Water level sensor terminals secure and correct sensor part number?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace water level sensor or repair connections.

steps.title: Replace level sensor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace water level sensor; replace PBA if fault persists.
